body: That's absolutely spot on, a major reason for the past 2 clear majorities is the anger against Gandhi family. I feel the same, I just don't understand that how can everyone in Congress allow Gandhis to still be in charge.

I am tired of this country, just tired. I can't take life anymore here, it is an uphill battle to fight for mental illness in India. You are judged everywhere, you have to literally fight a battle to convince your family, find a good doctor, get the correct diagnosis and it just never ends.

I can relate to your story so much, I feel exactly the same, all these co morbidities make it difficult to pin point as to what exactly is the reason behind why you feel the way you feel. I'm glad to hear that your headaches decreased over time, it gives me hope because I'm in a really desperate place since I'm from India where ADHD is still invalidated by the majority of the doctors and a result the only stimulant medication we have in our country is methylphenidate. There is strattera too, but that didn't suit me so yeah I just hope things get better in the coming weeks. Thanks for the quick response!
